result: Pinned modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk source establishes a minimal per-request dispatch witness. In StreamableHttpService::handle_post, lifecycle classification selects the stateless branch before session lookup when a non-initialize request carries protocol metadata that classifies to the stateless lifecycle. After request/header/meta validation, a request with per-request protocolVersion sets negotiates_per_request=true and is passed to serve_negotiated_request_directly. That function reconstructs peer_info from the current request/header and invokes serve_directly_with_ct without comparing against any prior initialize peer_info or stored SessionState. Thus, for this exact source path, a matching request-header/meta protocolVersion and structurally valid changed clientCapabilities are not rejected merely because they differ from a prior initialize context; the mechanism is transport rerouting to per-request stateless negotiation. Generic session/serve_inner behavior remains outside this positive witness.
